The official sheet for Phantasy Star Tabletop Roleplaying by Skydawn Game Studios. Licensed by SEGA.

  • Drag and drop species, backgrounds, professions, paths, feats, techniques, items, and monsters from the Phantasy Star Tabletop RPG compendium.
  • Auto-calculated stats, skills, bonuses, hit points, and technique points.
  • Roll buttons for checks, saves, attacks, damage, and techniques with rank boosting.
  • Sheets for both PCs and NPCs, including starships and vehicles.
  • Campaign options for the game's variant rules, such as Force Breach, Fate Pool, Combo Techniques, and Milestone Advancement.
